description: This file defines the AWS FMSClient class, used to interact with the Firewall Management Service. It includes method annotations for various operations such as associating accounts, listing policies, and managing resources, indicating it is a client class for AWS SDK PHP.

classes.name: FMSClient
classes.description: Client class for interacting with AWS Firewall Management Service (FMS). Extends AwsClient and provides methods to perform various firewall management operations.

methods.name: associateAdminAccount
methods.description: Associates an AWS account as the Firewall Administrator.

methods.name: associateAdminAccountAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously associates an AWS account as the Firewall Administrator.

methods.name: disassociateAdminAccountAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously disassociates the current Firewall Administrator.
